claims.statement: Local ports are 8080 (backend via air), 5173 (frontend via vite), 3306 (MySQL), 6379 (Redis), 8081 (Adminer), 9001 (9Pay mock), 9002 (OnePay mock), all from docker-compose.dev.yml.
The backend runs outside Docker via air hot-reload (backend/.air.toml); the dev convention is to never run the backend directly — only via air.
Admin endpoints /api/v1/admin/clock/{set,advance,reset,time} are mounted in dev so integration tests can advance time; they are NOT mounted in production.
Branch is main with no worktrees; commit format is <type>(<scope>): <subject>; make api-test runs after any feature change and pnpm lint && pnpm type-check runs after any frontend change.
